messages.content: Which planet is closest to the Sun? A) Venus B) Mercury C) Earth D) Mars. Answer with a single letter.
What gas do plants absorb from the air for photosynthesis? A) Oxygen B) Nitrogen C) Carbon dioxide D) Hydrogen. Answer with a single letter.
Which organelle is called the powerhouse of the cell? A) Nucleus B) Ribosome C) Mitochondrion D) Golgi apparatus. Answer with a single letter.
Which of these is a prime number? A) 9 B) 15 C) 21 D) 23. Answer with a single letter.
At what pressure does water boil at 100 degrees Celsius? A) Standard sea-level pressure B) Half of sea-level pressure C) Twice sea-level pressure D) It never boils. Answer with a single letter.
